verdict.rationale: ByteAsk publishes an official MCP server (ByteAsk-Embedded-MCP) on GitHub for embedded/firmware reference docs, which flips the agent's role from client to server-provider for this axis, and the probe confirms the repo exists. However, evidence is thin—just a repo link and one-line description with no setup docs, connection instructions, or independent confirmation of working agent integration. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on connecting/using the MCP server, hands-on or independent verification, and clarity on how broadly it's supported beyond this single embedded-docs use case.
